Every one of these errors is tagged v1.5.0 (#103, #114, #121). edge-proxy then returns 500s from account-svc on POST /login (#104, #128, #152, #165). verdict.recommendedAction: Roll account-svc back to v1.4.9 (build before d87c56e). Then fix user-formatter.ts:132 so it handles a missing parent object for 'currency' (e.g., use optional chaining or a default value), and add a test for users without that field before redeploying.
